task_description.overview: Estimate the Gutenberg-Richter a-value from a magnitude catalog using the classical maximum likelihood method.
steps: Load the array of earthquake magnitudes.
Specify the magnitude of completeness (mc) and magnitude discretization (delta_m).
Call the calculate method with mags, mc, and delta_m.
Retrieve the a-value from the estimator instance.

task_definition.agent_prompt:
Compute the a-value with given catalog at {catalog_path}. Loading the catalog, bin the magnitudes with delta_m={delta_m} and estimate the magnitude of completeness, then use `cat.estimate_a()` to calculate the a-value. 
 Note: 1) The `seismostats` libarary provide some functions to do catalog statistic analysis and ploting. Please refer to the `seismostats` provide some functions to assist. 
 2) Save the a-value data to {result_data.save name} with content {result_data.content}.
